 Rockets guard Marcus Smart suspended 3 games for throwing punch
 Smart was ejected from Nov. 11 matchup against Golden State for throwing a punch at Warriors forward-center Charles Bassey.
 Official release
 November 12, 2026 11:41 PM NEW YORK – Houston Rockets guard Marcus Smart has been suspended three games without pay for throwing a punch that made contact with the face of Golden State Warriors forward-center Charles Bassey, it was announced today by James Jones, Executive Vice President, Head of Basketball Operations.
 The incident, for which Smart was assessed a Flagrant Foul 2 and ejected, occurred with 0:21 remaining in the third quarter of the Rockets’ 115-108 win over the Warriors on Nov. 11 at Toyota Center.
 Smart will begin serving his suspension on Nov. 13 when the Rockets host the Utah Jazz at Toyota Center.
